raw_segments.text: Doing well, he could not do worse. He ruined his health and his estate amongst the worst
men and the worst women. He got into debt and into jail. His mother helped him out twice,
but as soon as he was free he returned to his old companions and habits. His head was
not strong. The knaves he lived amongst fooled him beyond anything I ever heard. He came
down to Gateshead about three weeks ago and wanted Mrs. to give up all to him.
Mrs. refused. Her means have long been much reduced by his extravagance, so he went back
again and the next news was that he was dead. How he died, God knows. They say he killed himself.
